cli.dotnet.unavailable: The dotnet CLI could not be started: {reason}
cli.graph.description: Print the application's capability graph (forwards to 'dotnet run -- graph').
cli.invoke.description: Invoke an operation of the application (forwards to 'dotnet run -- invoke'); '<resource> <verb>' is a shorthand.
cli.migrate.description: Rewrite a 4.x application for 5.0: migrate v4 [--path <dir|.csproj|.slnx>] [--fixers V4-01,V4-03] [--dry-run] [--report <file>].
cli.migrate.dry_run: Dry run: no files were written.
cli.migrate.entity.events: Domain event buffer; not mapped to a column.
cli.migrate.generated: Generated by xihan migrate v4; review before committing.
cli.migrate.marker.add_operations: Call context.AddGeneratedOperations() from the feature's Configure; the operations delegate to the original services, which the V4Services file registers as scoped.
cli.migrate.marker.app_interface: {name} has no 5.0 counterpart; declare it as an application interface.
cli.migrate.marker.application_builder: GetApplicationBuilder() has no counterpart in StartAsync; register middleware and endpoints in Program.cs after app.UseXiHan().
cli.migrate.marker.async_configure: Configure is synchronous; move awaited work to StartAsync.
cli.migrate.marker.concurrency_stamp_col: RowVersion (long) became ConcurrencyStamp (string); change the Row_Version column to a string type.
cli.migrate.marker.duplicate_verb: The operation verb was already used in this resource; '{verb}' got a numeric suffix, rename it by hand.
cli.migrate.marker.event_json: The event is serialized with reflection-based System.Text.Json; register the event type in a JsonSerializerContext and pass its JsonTypeInfo for AOT.
cli.migrate.marker.event_subscribe: ILocalEventBus.Subscribe has no 5.0 counterpart; register the handler with AddMessageHandler<THandler>(topic) in the feature's Configure.
cli.migrate.marker.event_topic_unresolve: The event type behind '{name}' could not be determined; set the topic by hand.
cli.migrate.marker.localization_catalog: Load the embedded catalog with MessageCatalog.FromEmbeddedResources("{domain}", typeof(<a type in this assembly>)) and add it to the localization feature; keys are {domain}.<resource>.<key>.
cli.migrate.marker.manual_registration: {name} could not be registered automatically (generic or outside a project); register it by hand.
cli.migrate.marker.module_registrations: The removed 4.x module {module} registered these services in its ConfigureServices; re-add in Configure the ones the application still uses: {registrations}
cli.migrate.marker.permission_simplified: Only the first permission expression became the contract permission; the others were dropped.
cli.migrate.marker.service_base_member: Logger / ServiceProvider came from ApplicationServiceBase; inject ILogger<T> or the needed service through the constructor.
cli.migrate.marker.shutdown_context: StopAsync receives no context; resolve what you need in StartAsync and keep it in a field.
cli.migrate.marker.tenant_id_type: TenantId became a string; change the Tenant_Id column type and the comparisons that used numbers.
cli.migrate.marker.unit_of_work_manager: IUnitOfWorkManager has no 5.0 counterpart: each operation gets one unit of work; inject the scoped IUnitOfWork for explicit control.
cli.migrate.marker.unsupported_operation: {name} could not become an operation (generic, ref/out parameters, streams or ASP.NET types); expose it by hand.
cli.migrate.summary: {files} files touched, {changed} edits, {markers} markers left for review.
cli.migrate.version_unknown: Unknown migration source '{version}'; only v4 is supported.
cli.operations.description: List the application's operations (forwards to 'dotnet run -- operations').
cli.pack.description: Generate deployment artifacts from xihan.app.json: pack [--manifest <path>] [--output <dir>] [--only dockerfile,kustomize,compose,aspire].
cli.pack.kind_unknown: Unknown artifact kind '{kind}'; expected dockerfile, kustomize, compose or aspire.
cli.pipeline.description: Print the application's pipeline (forwards to 'dotnet run -- pipeline').
